reviewers.summary: The hook handles package differences and HTTPS requests, but it rejects the explicitly permitted HTTP opt-in and does not emit the required refusal message.

findingList.message: The HTTP opt-in behavior and required refusal log message are not implemented.

evidence.codePathTraced: report_packages rejects every non-HTTPS URL when FLUXION_API_KEY is set and never checks FLUXION_ALLOW_HTTP from the environment or config. The rejection log also differs from the exact line required by the acceptance criterion.
evidence.failureScenario: With an HTTP API URL, API key k1, and FLUXION_ALLOW_HTTP=true, report sends no request instead of sending one with X-API-Key: k1. With the opt-in unset, it logs a different message than the required refusal line.

reviewers.summary: The hook rejects the explicitly permitted HTTP opt-in case. Its refusal log also does not match the required text, and the named test would not catch that mismatch.

findingList.message: The hook does not implement the explicit HTTP opt-in required by acceptance criterion 2.

evidence.codePathTraced: report_packages rejects every non-HTTPS URL when FLUXION_API_KEY is set and never checks FLUXION_ALLOW_HTTP.
evidence.failureScenario: With an HTTP API URL, API key k1, and FLUXION_ALLOW_HTTP=true in the environment or config, report sends no request, contrary to acceptance criterion 2.

findingList.message: The named test does not assert the exact HTTP refusal message required by acceptance criterion 2, and the current hook emits different text.

evidence.codePathTraced: The HTTP refusal case checks only that no request was captured; the generic ERROR assertion covers a later curl failure. The hook logs a different refusal message than the exact line part required by acceptance criterion 2.
evidence.failureScenario: If the hook emits any other refusal message, test_hook_fail_safe still passes, although the acceptance criterion requires `ERROR: refusing to send the API key over plain HTTP; set FLUXION_ALLOW_HTTP=true only on a trusted network`.

reviewers.summary: The hook reads configuration as data and passes the API key and URL as quoted arguments. When an API key is configured, it refuses non-HTTPS URLs; I found no security vulnerability in the changed code.
